events.caption: A **phrase** is one channel's part: 16 steps, played top to bottom.
events.title: The Phrase screen

events.caption: Tap [A] on an empty step. You get a note, and the instrument too.
events.title: Enter notes

events.caption: Hold [A] and press [RIGHT] or [LEFT] to move a note one semitone. [UP] or [DOWN]: one octave.
events.title: Change a note

events.caption: Rows 00 to 0F are the steps. Every fourth row is shaded: one beat.
events.title: Columns

events.label: NOT
events.text: The note. OFF releases it; --- is empty.

events.label: FX1  P1
events.text: An effect command and its hex parameter.

events.label: FX2  P2
events.text: A second effect lane. Both apply.

events.caption: Tap [A] in FX1 to add an effect, then hold [A] and press [LEFT] to pick the command.
events.title: Add an effect

events.caption: Arpeggio: root, +3, +7 semitones, one step per tick. Here: C, D#, G.
events.title: ARP 37

events.caption: [SELECT]+[START] loops the phrase. At **¼ speed**, every arp step is audible.
events.title: Playback

events.caption: Back to full tempo: 120 BPM, four rows to a beat.
events.title: Full tempo

events.caption: [L] backs out to the **chain**: its phrases play in order, top to bottom.
events.title: The Chain screen

events.label: TR
events.text: Transpose. 05 plays phrase 00 up five semitones.
